name: data-flow-diagramming
description: Privacy-focused data flow diagramming. Maps sources, flows, processors, storage, cross-border transfers, retention, and deletion for personal data. Classifies data categories (personal, special category, children's, biometric, financial), assigns GDPR legal basis per flow, flags high-risk points (third-country transfers, profiling, automated decisions), and produces a Mermaid data flow diagram plus RoPA-style register. Feeds DPIA work and aligns with control-framework-mapping.
